evidence.locator: Narcotic Drugs, Psychotropic Substances and Substance Abuse Rules and Regulation 2024, sections 1, 6-9; printed pages 3-5
evidence.issuer: Bhutan Food and Drug Authority, regulatory document hosted on its official website
evidence.qualification: BFDA-hosted regulation text and section 6 page screenshot inspected. Section 1 states an effective date of December 17, 2024 for this particular regulation. Section 6 cites Cabinet letter C-3/6(5)/2024/48 dated March 26, 2024 and RCSC letter LTD/1/COM/2024/3331 dated April 1, 2024 and lists nine board positions. The actual letters were not retrieved. A recital in a regulation is not a substitute for independently inspecting the original appointment instruments, their authority, conditions, subsequent amendments or continued effect. Its specific commencement date is not a universal BFDA succession or appointment date.

evidence.locator: Medical Product Division Annual Report 2024-25, printed pages 28 and 42, regulatory-system discussion and governing-board composition
evidence.issuer: Bhutan Food and Drug Authority, Medical Product Division
evidence.qualification: Original BFDA organizational report, not a statutory instrument. The report lists seven governing-board representations, whereas section 6 of the BFDA 2024 regulation lists nine positions. The report also allows the Minister or Secretary of Health as chairperson, differing from the regulation's Minister-only wording. The report says the Medicines Act had not yet been amended as of its reporting period and the revised Medicines Rules and Regulation 2025 awaited endorsement. These are time-bounded administrative assertions, not evidence that the proposals remained pending in November 2026. The composition discrepancy requires original appointment and amendment instruments before any conclusion about current legal membership.
